causality_contract.availability_rule: 60m CVD slope uses trades <= bar close; Donchian/range state uses bars <= close; availability_time = signal bar close

dataset_policy.allowed: certified Binance UM aggTrades day(s) + same-provenance holding data

deduplication.rule: one open position per symbol; signals while in position ignored

direction: Range position (lower half -> BULLISH toward range high; upper half -> BEARISH toward range low) with agreeing 60m CVD slope sign.

entry.rule: signal at range-touch bar close; market fill at next bar open
entry.timing: decision_time = touch bar close; entry_time = next bar open

event_definition: Prior-50 range (30-bar hold, strictly-prior bars) touch of the lower/upper boundary zone with agreeing 60-minute CVD slope sign (lower-half touch needs CVD slope > 0).
execution_model: NEXT_BAR_OPEN (certified channel; SL-first ambiguity; single position)
falsification: With sufficient evidence, pooled Cost-C expectancy <= 0 falsifies (FAIL).
invalidation: Close beyond the touched boundary against the position.
mechanism: Range extremes tested with supporting cumulative flow behind the holding side indicate absorption at the boundary rather than impending breakout.
negative_controls: boundary touch against CVD slope (expect null/negative)
research_question: Do CVD-confirmed range-boundary responses produce edge?
threshold_provenance: Range 50/30 = frozen 11G prior-range convention. CVD slope sign is structural (no magnitude threshold). Buffer 0.25 ATR = frozen.
